basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a tech enthusiast recently diving into the world of coding with a focus on Python. Originally from Morocco, I have a deep appreciation for our local cinema and culture. I'm currently working as a junior software developer in a small startup. In my free time, I enjoy exploring new games and occasionally engaging in online discussions about movies and tech. I'm single and usually online in the evenings after work, around 6 PM to 10 PM local time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of programming, primarily self-taught through online courses and tutorials. My interest in technology led me to explore different coding platforms, and I've recently started using PyCharm for my projects. I'm also a fan of indie games like Griftlands and Naraka: Bladepoint.
